'''Alan "Scipio" Crawford''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series appearing as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Scipio, at an unknown time, became involved in music management and became the manager of the successful rapper [[Madd Dogg]], helping him on his way to stardom. A jealous amateur rival [[OG Loc|Jeffrey "OG Loc" Cross]], an aspiring rapper, hires friend and protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] to [[Management Issues|kidnap and then kill]] Scipio in an attempt to sabotage Madd Dogg's career. Carl steals the limousine scheduled to pick Scipio up and then, after an awards ceremony, drives the car into the nearby bay, bailing out just before the car enters the water. Scipio's death sees Madd Dogg slowly turn to drugs and, as a consequence, becomes extremely depressed and [[Madd Dogg (mission)|attempts to kill himself]] after losing his [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] to [[Big Poppa]] of the [[Los Santos Vagos]]. Ironically, Carl ultimately replaces Scipio as Madd Dogg's manager.

;GTA San Andreas
*[[Management Issues]] <small>'''(Killed)'''</small>

==Trivia==
*Scipio claims to know [[Ballas]] OGs, saying that they are 'like brothers'.
*His character model appears on the poster for [[The Mainframe]] in [[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]].
*He has the same character model as a pedestrian. In addition, the character model looks strikingly similar to American rapper and actor [[:wp:Will Smith|Will Smith]].
*His outfit is based on that of Tre Styles on the front cover of the film ''Boyz n' The Hood''.
